In addition, Taufflieb (1966) reported it from another locality of Congo (Pointe-Noire) ex Crocidura sp. (Eulipotyphla: Soricidae); from Cameroon (Mbalmayo) ex Lophaetus occipitalis (Daudin) (Aves: Accipitriformes); from Angola (Dundo) ex Praomys morio (Trouessart); from the Central African Republic (Bangui) ex Rattus rattus; and from the Central African Republic (Boukoko) ex Praomys sp. and Lophuromys sikapusi.
